body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2005') -- <Visual News> ASIANA IDT(www.asianaidt.com) has introduced its new headset ‘earomix’. The most outstanding feature is that you can enjoy media files in any place. It can play digital music and video files and voice recorder is also included. It features one touch play system and SD card storage. It is compatible with almost every AV device in Korea. It includes rechargeable lithium-ion battery, which runs for up to 5 hours (audio/video) If you watch video clips with MP glass, it has the same effect as you watch 30-inch screen from 2m. so compared to the case you watch general monitor, you feel less tired with your eyes. If you are often frustrated with small screen of PMP or DMB phone, you might try. High resolution(266 x 225 x RGB) and weight 95g. <AVING Special Report Team for ‘KES2005’ : Editor&Publisher, Jason Lee, Joshua Shim, Nikki Whang, Sheri Choi, Sophia Kwag, Annie Park, Caleb Ma, edited by Daniel Sirh>
